questions.q:
Integer a, d, n, i, s
Set a = 2, d = 3, n = 5, s = 0
for(i = 0; i < n; i = i + 1)
  s = s + a
  a = a + d
end for
Print s

Integer a[3], i, p
Set a = {2, 3, 4}
Set p = 1
for(i = 0; i < 3; i = i + 1)
  p = p * a[i]
end for
Print p

Integer a, b
Set a = 9, b = 12
Print (a & b) + (a | b)

Integer n, r
Set n = 123, r = 0
while(n > 0)
  r = r * 10 + n MOD 10
  n = n / 10
end while
Print r

Integer i, j, c
Set c = 0
for(i = 1; i <= 2; i = i + 1)
  for(j = 1; j <= 4; j = j + 1)
    c = c + 1
  end for
end for
Print c

Integer a
Set a = 1
a = a << 10
Print a

Integer diff(Integer x, Integer y)
  if(x > y)
    return x - y
  else
    return y - x
  end if
End function
Print diff(15, 9)

Integer a, b
Set a = 6
b = a++ - --a
Print b

Integer rsum(Integer n)
  if(n == 0)
    return 0
  end if
  return (n MOD 10) + rsum(n / 10)
End function
Print rsum(123)

Integer x
Set x = 0
if(!x && (5 > 3))
  Print 1
else
  Print 0
end if

Integer n
Set n = 4
switch(n)
  case 2: Print 4
  case 4: Print 16
  case 6: Print 36
  default: Print 0
end switch

Integer a
Set a = 81
a = a / 9
a = a MOD 4
Print a
